headline: Gabriel Andronache: We Hope to Bring the Two Units at Cernavodă Back Into Operation in the Coming Period
summary: ANRE vice president Gabriel Andronache said Romania hopes to bring the two units at Cernavodă back into operation in the coming period.
why: Cernavodă is Romania's only nuclear power plant, and its reactors supply a significant share of domestic electricity, so restart timing matters for power supply and prices.

original_headline: Gabriel Andronache: Sperăm ca în perioada următoare să repunem în funcțiune cele două grupuri de la Cernavodă
